# Confirm restored opportunity links remain available after reload

## What & Why
The restore coverage checks core opportunity details but not the optional job URL. A regression could drop links while leaving the visible company, role, status, and notes intact.

## Done looks like
- Restore multiple opportunities with distinct URLs
- Reload the opportunity list
- Verify each restored card exposes the original URL in its expanded details
